tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: App background and sidebar. Neutral with a faint green bias.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Working surface: main content, sheets, phone screens. Always opaque outdoors.

tokens.name: sunk
tokens.usage: Portrait discs and quiet fills inside rows. Never a card background.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Current nav item and the highlighted employee row when a hexagon side is selected.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines (1 px) between rows and sections, and the six resting spokes. Decorative: never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text. 17.3:1 on surface (light), 14.5:1 (dark). Also highlighted spokes.

tokens.name: meta
tokens.usage: Metadata, secondary text, idle and unavailable states. 6.3:1 on surface (light), 7.5:1 (dark).

tokens.name: tenant
tokens.usage: GENERATED per tenant from tenant.config.json brand input (example tenant shown: Mowology, input #2D8659, pinned #1B5F3C). Exactly one role: the dominant action and the current-nav mark. White label ≥7:1 in light/field; dark ink ≥7:1 and ≥3:1 vs surface in dark.

tokens.name: on-tenant
tokens.usage: GENERATED with tenant. Label on a filled tenant button.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Ittai indigo. Brand moments only: wordmark, symbol, sign-in, marketing. Never inside working screens.

tokens.name: status-complete
tokens.usage: Work status: complete. Paired with the solid check icon.

tokens.name: status-attention
tokens.usage: Work status: needs attention. Paired with the triangle icon. 6.5:1 (light), 7.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: status-blocked
tokens.usage: Work status: blocked or failed. Paired with the sharp-cornered octagon. 7.3:1 (light), 6.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: status-progress
tokens.usage: Work status: in progress. Paired with the clock icon. Also the focus ring.

tokens.name: state-working
tokens.usage: AI employee state Working: solid side or ring + clock icon + the word.

tokens.name: state-approval
tokens.usage: AI employee state Waiting for approval: solid side or ring + triangle + the word.

tokens.name: state-blocked
tokens.usage: AI employee state Blocked: solid side or ring + octagon + the word.

tokens.name: state-idle
tokens.usage: AI employee state Idle: dotted side or dashed ring + dashed-circle icon + the word.

tokens.name: state-unavailable
tokens.usage: AI employee state Unavailable: side drops to 1 px + slashed-circle icon + the word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2 px keyboard focus ring, 2 px offset. 6.8:1 on surface (light), 7.8:1 (dark). Field: #24507A.

tokens.name: tenant-mark
tokens.usage: GENERATED. The tenant's brand as given, darkened only if needed to reach 3:1 on surface. Tenant logo/monogram tint only.

tokens.name: tenant-soft
tokens.usage: GENERATED. Selected/current tint for tenant-owned marks; text on it ≥7:1.

tokens.name: sync-saved
tokens.usage: Sync: saved on this device, not yet sent (cloud icon + 'Saved on phone'). Also offline approvals: 'Approval saved on phone · pending'.

tokens.name: sync-sending
tokens.usage: Sync: sending to the server (cloud-up + 'Sending…').

tokens.name: sync-sent
tokens.usage: Sync: the SERVER confirmed (cloud-check + 'Sent 9:14'). Never shown before confirmation.

tokens.name: sync-failed
tokens.usage: Sync: couldn't send (cloud-x + reason + Retry).

tokens.name: sync-conflict
tokens.usage: Sync: changed elsewhere or no longer valid (cloud-alert + 'Not sent: no longer needed' / 'Review').

styles.name: display-36
styles.usage: Rare. Large figures on report pages.

styles.name: title-22
styles.usage: Charlie's one-line brief; phone screen titles at 600.

styles.name: heading-18
styles.usage: Phone section headings; pulse figures at 500.

styles.name: heading-16
styles.usage: Desktop section headings, decision titles, customer names.

styles.name: body-14
styles.usage: Desktop body text and employee names (600).

styles.name: meta-13
styles.sample: Penny drafted reminder → you approve → Yui sends

styles.name: caption-12
styles.usage: State words, hexagon labels, pulse labels. Smallest size allowed.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark inside drawn corner brackets. Brand moments only.

tokens.name: space-1

tokens.name: space-3

tokens.usage: Phone section spacing.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between dashboard columns.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large separations.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Crew primary action height.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags (AI), kbd hints, nav items, focus rings.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and photo tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Crew primary action, sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Portraits and avatars.

shadow.note: Shadows only for sticky bars, menus and dialogs. Never at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-sticky
tokens.usage: Pinned action bar on phones.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Workspace sheets and dialogs.

stroke.note: Line weights for the AI Office Hexagon and hairlines.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Row dividers, resting spokes, the Unavailable side.

tokens.name: stroke-centre
tokens.usage: Charlie's centre circle; 2.5 px when the centre is selected.

tokens.name: stroke-side
tokens.usage: A hexagon side at rest.

tokens.name: stroke-side-selected
tokens.usage: The selected side; the other five drop to 25% opacity.

tokens.name: stroke-focus

size.note: Fixed sizes for the Six + One family and touch targets.

tokens.name: hex-full-width
tokens.usage: Full AI Office Hexagon at dashboard size (viewBox 232 × 204).

tokens.name: hex-compact
